Evidence & scope

The complete retained AI-data service, anonymous German construction-technology case, security and About texts were actually read in this new metadata phase. They support a commercial HabileData service brand providing managed sourcing, annotation, validation, enrichment and synthetic-data preparation, with published expert review, sampling, inter-annotator agreement and QA loops. The case directly describes annotator onboarding/training, manual annotation and auto-tag validation, two-stage QC and client-portal delivery, while the client remains unnamed and outcome/savings figures remain unverified provider reports. New exact source inspection resolves one old metadata uncertainty: security-page LF71 explicitly calls HabileData a division of HitechDigital Solutions LLP. That direct statement is stronger than the previously cited shared hiring disclaimer; preserve the old unresolved dossier as history, and retain org.habiledata as one group bridge without manufacturing a separate HitechDigital supplier count. This is public operating-division identity, not an independent registration/ownership audit. Source-reported 300 AI experts and 1200 BPO professionals are different unverified workforce scopes, not active annotator counts. Accuracy, throughput, customer testimonials, zero-breach claims and security certificates are not independently validated. Published NDAs, retention/destruction and customer ownership/control statements do not establish an executed engagement or upstream source-data rights. This scoped capability/process/identity/limits audit supports supplier classification conditional on separate coordinator metadata acceptance and import of the exact five already-three-role-passed own-subject facts; it creates no new scientific wording/PASS, operational quality guarantee, whole-catalog rights or research-function closure.
